name: Truc Lam Phuong Nam
nameVi: Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam
kicker: Zen monastery on the Phong Điền road
summary: Walk the tiled halls if the Phong Điền loop already has you at Mỹ Khánh. The department advice page puts the monastery a few hundred metres from the garden village and about 15 km from the centre, on nearly 4 ha. A fee and the hours were not printed. Check on arrival. The 145 billion VND figure is a construction value, not a ticket.
getThere: With Mỹ Khánh, about 15 km from the centre
heroCaption: Tiled halls and the court at Trúc Lâm Phương Nam

notice.title: 145 billion VND is not a ticket
notice.body: The department advice page prints 145 billion VND as a construction value. It does not print an admission price. Check on arrival for a fee.

body: The department advice page calls Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam nearly 4 ha and the largest zen monastery in the delta on that account, with timber columns, tile roofs, and ship-tile floors. It places the monastery a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh and about 15 km from the centre. Department tour texts say đường Mỹ Nhơn, phường An Bình, and also xã Mỹ Khánh, huyện Phong Điền.

Go in the daytime, on the same road as the orchard hour, after the dawn boats. A counted visit was not printed. Check on arrival. A fee was not printed. Check on arrival. Minutes from Ninh Kiều were not printed beyond the about 15 km. Check on arrival for the drive.

figures.caption: The gate at Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam

gettingThere: The monastery is on đường Mỹ Nhơn, a few hundred metres from Làng du lịch Mỹ Khánh at 335 Lộ Vòng Cung, about 15 km from the centre on the department advice page. Pair it with the garden village. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ninh Kiều
legs.body: By road toward Phong Điền, about 15 km on the department advice page. A minute count was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Mỹ Khánh
legs.body: A few hundred metres, on the department advice page. Walk or ride the short gap. A minute count was not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. The department advice page does not print a daily clock.
closed: A weekly closing day was not printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. No ticket was printed. The 145 billion VND on the department advice page is a construction value.
